newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cerus H1 net profit edges higher.
newsitem.headline: Cerus H1 net profit edges higher.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - Cerus gave its results in a statement. It said car parts maker Valeo, which posted first-half net profit of 656 million francs, contributed 166 million francs. Cofir of Spain, which posted first half profit of 488 million pesetas, contributed profit of 9.1 million francs.

It raised 500 million francs in the first half from the sale of its stake in Cofinc and a reduction in Cofir's capital, which it used to pay down debt. It continues to repay debt in the second half. It sold the Societe Financiere de Geneve in July for nine million Swiss francs. At end-June, shareholder equity stood at 3,899 million francs against net debt of 2,066 million. It gave no comparisons.
